question: What is the main goal of written exams in midwifery training?

options.A: To measure physical energy during long shifts
options.B: To check practical bedside delivery skills directly
options.C: To test book knowledge and understanding
options.D: To watch patient communication in real-time

explanation: Written exams focus on evaluating cognitive frameworks and academic facts rather than physical clinical skills. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h1)

question: Why must written exams be paired with other assessment methods in midwifery?

options.A: Written tests cannot measure hands-on clinical skills
options.B: Nursing and midwifery councils forbid paper-only grading
options.C: Clinical postings are too costly to run without tests
options.D: Students fail when tested exclusively on paper

explanation: Paper exams evaluate the mind, but safe practice requires practical psychomotor skills that must be tested separately. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h1)

question: Which of these is a classic example of an objective test item?
explanation: Multiple-choice questions have fixed, predetermined correct answers, making them strictly objective. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h2)

question: An educator wants to test a student's ability to build a logical care plan for a complex labor. Which format works best?
explanation: Essays give students the freedom to organize thoughts, justify choices, and demonstrate deep critical thinking. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h2)

question: What is the main purpose of a test blueprint when planning a midwifery exam?

options.A: To find out which students need extra clinical coaching
options.B: To schedule the exact times supervisors must enter the hall
options.C: To match question distribution with teaching time and topic importance
options.D: To calculate the printing cost of question papers

explanation: A blueprint ensures that the exam reflects the curriculum weight and spends appropriate time on core topics. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h3)

question: Why is anonymous grading helpful when scoring essay papers?

options.A: It guarantees that every student will pass
options.B: It makes tallying total scores much faster
options.C: It stops lecturer bias based on a student's past reputation
options.D: It removes the need for a marking guide

explanation: Hiding names stops personal impressions from swaying how a marker grades an open-ended essay. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h3)

question: Which body sets the required clinical skills for midwifery training in Nigeria?

options.C: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria

explanation: The Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria sets the legal standards and core competencies for all local midwifery programs. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h4)

question: What happens when written exam questions do not match real clinical skills?

options.A: Examiners spend less time writing new test questions
options.B: The pass rate for the institution automatically increases
options.C: Clinical postings become much easier to finish
options.D: Students memorize useless facts that do not help at the bedside

explanation: Poor alignment shifts student focus away from practical lifesaving knowledge toward useless academic memorization. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h4)

question: Which of these is a major mistake when writing multiple-choice options?

options.A: Creating obviously silly or fake distractors
options.B: Making the correct answer the exact same length as others
options.C: Using clear and straightforward language in every option
options.D: Ensuring all choices relate directly to the question

explanation: Distractors that make no sense allow students to guess the right answer easily without knowing the content. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h5)

question: Why should educators avoid trick questions or confusing wording in midwifery exams?

options.A: They make the grading guide too hard to calculate
options.B: They test reading confusion instead of actual clinical knowledge
options.C: They stop students from finishing the exam within one hour
options.D: They take too long to type on a standard computer

explanation: Trick questions measure a student's ability to decipher confusing English rather than their understanding of midwifery. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h5)

question: What does 'validity' mean when discussing written exams?

options.A: The students finish answering all questions within the time limit
options.B: The final scores are posted on the notice board on time
options.C: The test accurately measures what it is supposed to measure
options.D: The exam papers are printed clearly without spelling errors

explanation: Validity ensures that a clinical test assesses real midwifery capability rather than unrelated traits like writing speed. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h6)

question: Which scenario shows high test reliability in a midwifery training program?

options.A: Two different tutors grading the same paper give nearly identical scores
options.B: The exam questions are kept extremely difficult and secret
options.C: Students complete the written paper in less than thirty minutes
options.D: Every single student in the class passes on the first attempt

explanation: Reliability means consistency, meaning different markers should arrive at the same score for the same work. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T9#BMP312_U3_T9_h6)
